item.title: Luxury Corporate Gift Boxes
item.description: A client opens a box at their desk, feels the weight of the lid, sees the logo embossed cleanly on the interior panel, and understands in that moment that the company who sent it operates at a different level. That understanding happens before a single product is removed. It is the entire purpose of investing in packaging that matches the relationship it represents.
